correctness.rationale: Exact orthogonality yields the coupled I0 Gram kernel and squared Schatten-four trace. The harmonic counting measure differs from logarithmic Lebesgue by a bounded boundary functional with exponentially decaying primitive; the correction has a continuous first translation derivative. Laplace diagonal change of variables, Gaussian Bessel asymptotic and dominated convergence give Q_d(x)~K_d x^{1/2-d}. Abelian integrals give the explicit one-prime blow-up, two-prime cusp and finite derivative for at least three primes; finite supplementary numerical checks agree. Limitations exclude amplitude/dimension uniformity.
